The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
The test_word_summary_content in /tests/test_outputs.py failed with 'AssertionError: Word summary must mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations' (assert 0 >= 2). While 5 tests passed, the final OUTPUT_DOCX lacked the expected facility-session identifiers (e.g., 'fac-sess') in its text content. Avoid omitting specific session IDs from the summary paragraphs, as the verifier requires at least two high-priority combinations to be explicitly mentioned.
